screen: The Pit (community feed) — phone index 3, route `pit`, nav tab `pit`
summary: The Pit is the community discussion feed: a large display title with a live-population line, a three-way pill segmented control (Following / Latest / Popular, default Latest), and a vertical list of post cards each carrying a kind chip, a ticker chip, title, excerpt, author line and a like/comment/save footer. It is the only screen that renders the orange circular compose FAB, and it sits on the shared glass bottom nav with the Pit tab lit.

sections.name: Phone shell + scroll viewport (shared frame)
sections.description: The screen is drawn inside the canvas phone mock. Outer frame is 390x844 with a 46px corner radius and overflow hidden, filled with the vertical page gradient. All Pit content lives in a single absolutely-positioned scroll container that fills the frame; the 54px top padding clears the status bar and the 124px bottom padding clears the glass nav + scrim. Usable content width is 390 - 16 - 16 = 358px. Scrollbars are hidden globally (`*::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0;display:none}` plus `scrollbar-width:none`).
sections.layout: frame: position:relative; width:390px; height:844px; border-radius:46px; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EDE8E2 0%,#E3DCD4 100%); box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(27,25,23,.20), 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.07). scroller: position:absolute; inset:0; overflow-y:auto; scrollbar-width:none; padding:54px 16px 124px; box-sizing:border-box. Root font-family on the canvas: Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif

sections.name: Status bar (shared chrome, non-interactive)
sections.description: Fixed faux iOS status bar over the scroll area. Left is the time '9:41'; right is three abstract indicator pills (signal / wifi / battery) with differing opacities. pointer-events:none so it never intercepts taps.
sections.layout: position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:54px; z-index:6; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 26px; pointer-events:none; font:500 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Right group: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px — pill A 16x9px border-radius:2px background:#1B1917 opacity:.85; pill B 5x9px border-radius:1px background:#1B1917 opacity:.5; pill C 22x10px border-radius:3px background:#1B1917 opacity:.85

sections.name: Screen root column
sections.description: Single flex column holding header, tab bar and the post list. Enters with the shared bRise animation (used identically on every screen in this design).

sections.name: Header block (title + population line)
sections.description: Title 'The Pit' in Outfit Light 36px, with a secondary line beneath giving community size and daily activity. The wrapper is a flex row with align-items:flex-end / justify-content:space-between but contains only one child — there is no right-hand action on this screen; the row exists so a trailing control could be dropped in without relayout.
sections.layout: wrapper: padding-top:6px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between. Title: font:300 36px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#1B1917. Sub: margin-top:8px; font:400 13px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums

sections.name: Segmented tab bar — Following / Latest / Popular
sections.description: Pill-in-pill segmented control. Track is a paper-coloured 999px pill with 4px internal padding and 4px gaps; the selected segment gets a white fill plus its own soft shadow, unselected segments are transparent with muted text. Exactly one is selected; component state key is `pit` with values 'following' | 'latest' | 'popular', seeded to 'latest' — so Latest is the ON tab in the default render. Each segment is flex:1, so at 358px content width each measures (358 - 8 padding - 8 gaps) / 3 = 114px wide, 35px tall (11 + 13 + 11); the track is 43px tall.
sections.layout: track: display:flex; gap:4px; background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:999px; padding:4px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.06). TAB_ON: flex:1; text-align:center; padding:11px 0; border-radius:999px; background:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(27,25,23,.10); font:400 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; cursor:pointer; transition:all 220ms ease-out. TAB_OFF: flex:1; text-align:center; padding:11px 0; border-radius:999px; font:400 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D; cursor:pointer; transition:all 220ms ease-out (no background, no shadow)

sections.name: Post list
sections.description: Vertical stack of post cards driven by `sc-for list="{{ posts }}" as="o"` with hint-placeholder-count=3. Three seed posts are rendered. NOTE: the design does not filter or reorder the list per tab — the same three posts render for Following / Latest / Popular. Per-tab datasets are NOT specified in the file.

sections.name: Post card (repeated x3)
sections.description: Paper card containing, top to bottom: a chip row, a tappable title+excerpt block, an author row with a striped avatar, and a hairline-separated metrics footer. The whole card scales down slightly while pressed.
sections.layout: background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:28px; padding:20px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active state: transform:scale(0.99). Inner content width = 358 - 40 = 318px

sections.name: Post card — chip row
sections.description: Row of up to two chips: a kind chip (Question / Analysis / Source) rendered in one of two mutually-exclusive variants, then the black ticker chip. The ember variant renders when `o.ember` is true, the plain variant when `o.plain` is true; they are separate sc-if blocks, never both true in the seed data. The plain block carries hint-placeholder-val=true so placeholder previews show the plain chip. The ticker chip is a separate tap target from the rest of the card.
sections.layout: row: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px. Ember chip: padding:5px 11px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(232,98,28,.55); font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#E8621C; background transparent (card #F7F4F0 shows through). Plain chip: padding:5px 11px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(27,25,23,.18); font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#5C554F. Ticker chip: padding:5px 11px; border-radius:999px; background:#1B1917; font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#F5F1EC; cursor:pointer. All chips are 20px tall (5+10+5)

sections.name: Post card — title + excerpt (tap target -> post detail)
sections.description: A single wrapper div with cursor:pointer and onClick=goPost containing the headline and the two-to-three line excerpt. Text is not clamped in the design — no line-clamp, no ellipsis, no max-height; cards grow with content.
sections.layout: wrapper: cursor:pointer. Title: margin-top:14px; font:300 22px/1.22 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:#1B1917. Body: margin-top:10px; font:400 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#5C554F

sections.name: Post card — author row
sections.description: 28px circular avatar rendered as a diagonal two-tone stripe pattern (no photo, no initials in this design), followed by the author name in ink and the relative age in a muted colour, separated by a middle dot. The separator lives inside the muted span and includes a leading space: `{{o.author}} · {{o.ago}}`.
sections.layout: row: margin-top:16px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px. Avatar: width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:999px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 3px,#E8E2DB 3px 6px). Text: font:400 12px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; age span color:#9A938C

sections.name: Post card — metrics footer
sections.description: Separated from the body by a 1px inset top hairline (implemented as an inset box-shadow, not a border). Contains a like count with a circle-and-bar glyph, a comment count with a rounded-rect bubble glyph, and a right-pushed Save action with a bookmark glyph. In this screen the counts and Save are STATIC — the like/save toggles (toggleLike, likeStyle, toggleSave, saveStyle, likeCount 131/132) exist in the component but are wired to the Post detail screen, not to these cards. Icons inherit the row colour via currentColor (#7A736D).
sections.layout: row: margin-top:16px; padding-top:14px; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.08); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; font:400 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Each item: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px. Save item additionally: margin-left:auto. Icons all width=15 height=15 viewBox='0 0 15 15', stroke-width 1.4, stroke/fill currentColor

sections.name: Compose FAB (Pit-only chrome)
sections.description: Rendered by the shared trailing chrome under `sc-if p.isPit` — this is the ONLY screen that shows it. A 62px orange gradient circle with a light '+', floating above the nav bar at the right edge. Purely visual in the design: no onClick handler is bound.
sections.layout: position:absolute; right:20px; bottom:108px; width:62px; height:62px; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F0752E 0%,#E8621C 100%); box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(232,98,28,.38), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.42) inset, 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:200 32px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; color:#FFF; z-index:8; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 220ms ease-out; active: transform:scale(0.94)

sections.name: Bottom scrim + glass nav (shared, Pit tab active)
sections.description: A non-interactive fade scrim sits behind the floating glass nav. The nav has four equal tabs (Home, Market, Pit, You); on this screen `nav === 'pit'` so the selected pill is translated to the third slot and the Pit icon is accent-orange with a glowing 4px dot beneath it. Inactive icons are near-white at 76% and carry no dot. Only describe/rebuild this once; the Pit-specific part is the pill offset + lit Pit icon.
sections.layout: scrim: position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:118px; z-index:5; pointer-events:none; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(232,225,216,0) 0%,rgba(230,222,213,.34) 52%,rgba(227,220,212,.62) 100%). Bar: position:absolute; left:16px; right:16px; bottom:22px; height:66px; z-index:7; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(27,25,23,.58); backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(180%); display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 6px; box-sizing:border-box; box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(27,25,23,.26), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.30) inset, 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.13), 0 -8px 20px rgba(255,255,255,.05) inset. Selected pill (Pit): position:absolute; left:6px; top:6px; bottom:6px; width:calc((100% - 12px) / 4); transform:translateX(200%); border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.20) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 100%); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.32) inset, 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18); animation:bPill 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1). Top sheen: position:absolute; left:14px; right:14px; top:1px; height:1px; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,0) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.42) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%). Each tab: position:relative; z-index:1; flex:1; height:66px; column flex; align/justify center; gap:5px. Pit icon svg 21x21 viewBox '0 0 20 20': circle cx=8 cy=8.5 r=5.5 fill currentColor + circle cx=13 cy=12 r=5.5 fill currentColor opacity=.5. Active colour #FF8340 + dot 4x4px border-radius:999px background:#FF8340 box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,131,64,.9). Inactive colour rgba(245,241,236,.76), no dot

sections.name: Specified-but-not-rendered-here: Following empty state
sections.description: Lives on the STATES screen and is clearly the Pit 'Following' empty case. Rebuild it as the empty state for the Following tab. Copy is verbatim from the design.
sections.layout: background:#F7F4F0; border-radius:28px; padding:28px 20px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.06); text-align:center. Title: font:300 22px/1.2 Outfit,sans-serif; color:#1B1917. Sub: margin-top:8px; font:400 13px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D

sections.name: Specified-but-not-rendered-here: reported post card
sections.description: Also on the STATES screen; it is a post-card variant, so it belongs to the Pit feed. Replaces a post card in place with an 'Under review' chip, an explanation and an Undo affordance. Note the smaller radius (24px) and padding (18px) versus a live post card.

Chip: padding:5px 11px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(27,25,23,.08); font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#5C554F. Body: margin-top:12px; font:400 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D. Undo: margin-top:12px; font:400 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917

Shared constants defined once in the component script (lines ~867-868) and reused by every segmented control in the app.

Measured: segment 114x35px at 358px content width, track 43px tall

interactions: Tab 'Following' — onClick sets state.pit = 'following'; the segment swaps from TAB_OFF to TAB_ON. Transition: `all 220ms ease-out` (background, box-shadow and colour cross-fade; the design does NOT slide a shared pill in this control, unlike the bottom nav).
Tab 'Latest' — onClick sets state.pit = 'latest'. This is the seeded default, so Latest renders as TAB_ON on first paint.

IMPORTANT: switching tabs in the design changes ONLY the pill styling. The `posts` array is not filtered, sorted or replaced. No per-tab dataset, no loading state on switch, and no list transition are specified.

Ticker chip tap (p.goCompany) — routes to the Company screen (route 'company'); does not change the bottom-nav selection (goCompany is called with no nav argument, so `nav` stays 'pit' and the Pit tab remains lit).

Title/excerpt block tap (p.goPost) — routes to the Post detail screen (route 'post'); again no nav change, Pit tab stays lit. The previous route is stored in `prev` so the detail screen's back button returns here.
Post card press — `style-active: transform:scale(0.99)` with `transition:transform 220ms ease-out`. Applies to the whole card even though the card itself has no tap handler.
FAB press — `style-active: transform:scale(0.94)` with `transition:transform 220ms ease-out`. No onClick is bound in the design; the destination compose screen is NOT specified.
Screen entry — the root column plays `bRise` 240ms ease-out: opacity 0 -> 1 and translateY(4px) -> 0.
Bottom-nav selection pill — `bPill` 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1) (opacity 0 -> 1 with a slight overshoot curve); the pill's position is set by transform translateX(n*100%), 200% for Pit.

Like / comment / Save in the card footer — NO interaction in this screen. They are plain static spans. The like toggle (accent #E8621C, count 131<->132, `transition:color 200ms ease-out`) and the save toggle (42x42 button, radius 16px, ink fill #1B1917 / icon #F5F1EC when saved, `transition:all 200ms ease-out`) exist only on the Post detail screen.

Not specified anywhere in the file: pull-to-refresh, infinite scroll / pagination, scroll-to-top on re-tapping the Pit nav tab, unread badge, long-press menu, report affordance entry point (only the resulting 'Under review' card is designed), and the FAB destination.
flutterNotes:
STRUCTURE
- Scaffold with `extendBody: true` and a `Stack`: (1) scrollable content, (2) bottom scrim, (3) glass nav, (4) FAB. Do NOT use Scaffold.floatingActionButton — the FAB here is at exactly right:20, bottom:108 relative to the frame, which does not match any FloatingActionButtonLocation. Use `Positioned(right: 20, bottom: 108)`.
- Content: `CustomScrollView`/`ListView` with `padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 54, 16, 124)`. Wrap with `ScrollConfiguration(behavior: ...copyWith(scrollbars: false))`. The 54px top pad is the status-bar clearance in the mock; on a real device use `MediaQuery.padding.top` and keep the 124px bottom as `22 + 66 + 36` clearance above the home indicator.
- Root column `gap: 20` → use `Column(children: [...])` with `SizedBox(height: 20)` separators, or a `Column` + `spacing: 20` (Flutter 3.27+).

TYPE
- Two families: `Outfit` for display (weights 200/300/400/500) and `IBM Plex Sans Arabic` for all UI labels, numerals and Arabic (weights 300/400/500). Register both in pubspec with the exact weights.
- CSS `font: W SIZE/LH` maps to `TextStyle(fontWeight, fontSize, height: LH)`. `/1` means `height: 1.0` — set it explicitly or Flutter's default line height will inflate chip and tab heights and break the measured 20px/35px boxes.
- `letter-spacing` is in em: -0.03em at 36px = -1.08px; -0.01em at 22px = -0.22px; .06em at 10px = 0.6px. Flutter's `letterSpacing` is logical px, so multiply yourself.
- `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` → `fontFeatures: [FontFeature.tabularFigures()]` on the subtitle, the footer metrics and the status bar. Without it the like/comment counts jitter.

COLOUR / ALPHA CONVERSIONS (rgba -> ARGB)
- rgba(27,25,23,.08) = 0x141B1917 · .06 = 0x0F1B1917 · .10 = 0x1A1B1917 · .18 = 0x2E1B1917 · .58 = 0x941B1917 · .26 = 0x421B1917
- rgba(232,98,28,.55) = 0x8CE8621C · .38 = 0x61E8621C
- rgba(245,241,236,.76) = 0xC2F5F1EC · rgba(255,131,64,.9) = 0xE6FF8340
- rgba(255,255,255,.42/.32/.30/.20/.16/.13/.07/.05) = 0x6B/0x51/0x4D/0x33/0x29/0x21/0x12/0x0D white.

SHADOWS
- CSS `0 Ypx Bpx rgba(...)` → `BoxShadow(offset: Offset(0, Y), blurRadius: B, color: ...)`. CSS blur B ≈ 2σ, and Flutter's blurRadius is already ≈2σ, so use the number as-is; it matches closely enough at these sizes.
- `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px C` is NOT a shadow — it is a 1px inner border. Use `BoxDecoration(border: Border.all(color: C, width: 1), borderRadius: ...)`. This is how both kind chips get their outline; getting this wrong makes the chips 2px wider.
- `box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.08)` on the card footer is a 1px top hairline. Use `Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0x141B1917), width: 1))), padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 14))`.

TRICKY BITS
1. Striped avatar. `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 3px,#E8E2DB 3px 6px)` has no Flutter equivalent. Build it with `ClipOval(child: SizedBox(28,28, child: CustomPaint(painter: _Stripes())))` — fill #E8E2DB, then draw 3px-wide #D9D2CA bands on a 6px period along an axis rotated so the bands run bottom-left→top-right ("/"). Alternatively a `RotationTransition`-free `Transform.rotate(angle: -pi/4)` over a repeating `LinearGradient` with hard stops (`stops: [0, .5, .5, 1]`, `tileMode: TileMode.repeated`) sized so one tile = 6px along the gradient axis.
2. Glass nav + FAB gradient. `backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(180%)` → `ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)) + BackdropFilter(filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 13, sigmaY: 13))` (CSS blur radius ≈ 2σ, so 26px ≈ σ13) with a `Color(0x941B1917)` overlay on top. Flutter has no saturate filter — either accept the loss or add a `ColorFilter.matrix` saturation matrix chained via `ImageFilter.compose`. Inset highlight shadows (`0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.30) inset`) have no BoxShadow equivalent: draw them as 1px gradient strips (the design already does this separately for the top sheen at left:14/right:14/top:1).
3. Selection pill offset. `width: calc((100% - 12px)/4)` with `translateX(200%)` — compute as `(navWidth - 12) / 4` and left = `6 + 2 * pillWidth`. Animate with `AnimatedPositioned` (320ms, `Curves.easeOutBack`-ish; the exact curve is cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1) → `Cubic(0.32, 1.2, 0.44, 1.0)`).
4. Card press scale. `style-active: transform:scale(0.99)` → `GestureDetector` + `AnimatedScale(scale: _pressed ? 0.99 : 1.0, duration: 220ms, curve: Curves.easeOut)`. Same pattern for the FAB at 0.94. Note the card has NO tap handler of its own — only the ticker chip and the title/excerpt block are tappable — so use `Listener`/`onTapDown` for the press feedback and keep two separate `GestureDetector`s inside for navigation.
5. Icons. Rebuild the three 15x15 footer glyphs as `CustomPainter` (or inline SVG via flutter_svg) using the exact geometry listed in the section notes; stroke width 1.4, `PaintingStyle.stroke`, `strokeCap`/join default, colour #7A736D. The nav Pit icon is two filled circles in a 20x20 viewBox scaled to 21x21 — r=5.5 at (8,8.5) full opacity and r=5.5 at (13,12) at 50% opacity, both `currentColor`.
6. Segmented control: `flex:1` segments → `Row(children: [Expanded(...), SizedBox(4), Expanded(...), SizedBox(4), Expanded(...)])` inside a 999px `Container` with `padding: EdgeInsets.all(4)`. Animate with `AnimatedContainer(duration: 220ms, curve: Curves.easeOut)` per segment — the design cross-fades each segment's own decoration; it does not slide a shared indicator.
7. Post text is unclamped in the design (no line-clamp / ellipsis / fixed card height). If you clamp for production that is a deviation — decide deliberately and pick maxLines with `TextOverflow.ellipsis`.

PRODUCT-RULE COMPLIANCE (must hold in the rebuild)
- Nothing on this screen expresses BUY / SELL / TARGET / STOP / EXPECTED RETURN, and nothing should be added. The chips are epistemic labels (Question / Analysis / Source), not recommendations. Keep them that way.
- The only colour-carrying semantic is the ember kind chip (#E8621C for 'Question'). It is already accompanied by its text label, so it satisfies the never-colour-alone rule — do not replace the label with a coloured dot. Likewise the active nav tab pairs colour with a dot indicator, and 'Under review' pairs its grey chip with the word.
- Nothing on this screen is labelled with data age except the per-post relative timestamps (6h / 11h / 1d). The subtitle '2,418 investors · 61 active today' reads as live and has no age label — if the counts are cached, add the stale-data pill (rgba(27,25,23,.06) 999px pill, 11px 16px padding, 7px #7A736D dot, 12px/1.3 #5C554F text) directly under the header, inside the 20px root gap.
- Accessibility: the like/comment/save glyphs have no text alternative in the markup. Add `Semantics(label: '131 likes' / '48 comments' / 'Save post')` — the numbers alone are ambiguous.

RTL / ARABIC (direction-sensitive items, all must flip)
- `margin-left: auto` on the Save item → use `Spacer()` inside the Row so it end-aligns automatically, or `EdgeInsetsDirectional`. A hard-coded left margin will strand Save on the wrong side.
- FAB at `right: 20px` → `PositionedDirectional(end: 20, bottom: 108)`.
- Nav selection pill `translateX(200%)` → in RTL the tab order mirrors, so compute the offset from the start edge with `PositionedDirectional` rather than a raw left/translate.
- Author line `{name} · {ago}` — the middle dot with its leading space is a bidi hazard. Build it as a single `RichText` with explicit `TextDirection` and consider `‏`/`‎` marks, or lay the two spans out in a Row so the separator cannot reorder.
- Chip row order (kind chip, then ticker chip) reverses in RTL — correct, and `Row` handles it if you avoid `Directionality.of` overrides.
- The 135deg avatar stripe gradient mirrors under `Directionality` in CSS-like systems but will NOT in a CustomPainter; decide whether to mirror it (cosmetic only).
- `letter-spacing: .06em` on the ticker chip must be dropped for Arabic text — letter-spacing breaks Arabic joining. Apply it only when the label matches `[A-Z]+`.
- Tabular numerals: the counts, the '2,418' figure and the ages must stay Latin-digit or be converted with a locale-aware formatter; the design uses Latin digits with a comma thousands separator.
- `text-align: center` inside the tab segments is direction-neutral; the header title uses default (start) alignment and will flip correctly.
